purpose: Define measurable performance targets for AI/ML/NLP/Automission while preventing accuracy, speed, or automation from being confused with truth or independent verification.

evaluation_dimensions.factual_accuracy: measure against independently curated evaluation sets
evaluation_dimensions.precision_recall: report per task and per relevant class, not only aggregate
evaluation_dimensions.robustness: test adversarial, malformed, ambiguous, and distribution-shift inputs
evaluation_dimensions.reproducibility: pin code, configuration, model/version and input/output hashes
evaluation_dimensions.latency: report p50, p95 and p99 rather than a single average
evaluation_dimensions.recovery: measure detection and safe recovery from failed agents/workflows
